headline: Nike (NKE) Launches Studio Fleece To Rebuild Its Women's Sportswear Business
summary: Nike has launched its new Studio Fleece line, a women's sportswear collection centered on versatile essentials like hoodies and sweatpants. The release targets the athleisure segment and comes as the company looks to refresh its women's offering during 2026. The collection is positioned as a simple, mix and match range that sets up further product drops later this year.
